source_note: Curated from NAIC model laws, state DOI regulations, and federal guidance. NOT derived from FAOS ontology blueprints (E1 anti-circularity).

requirements.requirement: Calculate Risk-Based Capital ratio and identify company action level (200%, 150%, 100%, 70%)
Conduct Own Risk and Solvency Assessment annually for insurers with >$500M premium

requirements.source: NAIC Unfair Claims Settlement Practices Act (Model #900)
requirements.requirement: Do not misrepresent pertinent facts or policy provisions relating to coverage
Acknowledge and act reasonably promptly upon receipt of claim communications
Attempt fair and equitable settlement when liability is reasonably clear
Pay undisputed claims within statutory timeframe (typically 30-45 days after proof of loss)

requirements.source: NAIC Property & Casualty Rate Filing Model Law
requirements.requirement: Rates must not be excessive, inadequate, or unfairly discriminatory
All policy forms must be filed with and approved by state DOI before use
Verify producer licensing status before accepting agent-submitted business

requirements.source: NAIC Accounting Practices and Procedures Manual
requirements.requirement: Apply Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP) for regulatory financial reporting, not GAAP

requirements.source: NAIC Statement of Statutory Accounting Principles No. 55
requirements.requirement: Establish loss reserves based on individual case estimates plus IBNR (Incurred But Not Reported)
Calculate combined ratio as (loss ratio + expense ratio) to assess underwriting profitability
Calculate loss ratio as (incurred losses + LAE) / earned premium

requirements.source: NAIC Market Conduct Surveillance Model Law
requirements.requirement: Maintain complaint records and respond to DOI market conduct inquiries

requirements.source: NAIC Insurance Data Security Model Law (Model #668)
requirements.requirement: Implement information security program protecting nonpublic information
Do not compel insureds to institute litigation to recover amounts due by offering substantially less than value
Apply consistent underwriting guidelines without unfair discrimination based on protected classes

requirements.source: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law (Model #785)
requirements.requirement: Only take credit for reinsurance from authorized or certified reinsurers

requirements.source: NAIC Insurance Fraud Prevention Model Act (Model #680)
requirements.requirement: Maintain Special Investigation Unit (SIU) or fraud detection program
Document claim investigation findings and communicate basis for claim decisions
Monitor premium-to-surplus ratio (leverage) as indicator of financial strength
Assess probable maximum loss (PML) and catastrophe exposure relative to capital
Determine coverage based on policy effective dates, exclusions, and conditions
Report material transactions between affiliated entities within insurance holding company system
Do not engage in misleading advertising or misrepresentation of policy benefits
